@@U02212@@
this roaring waterfall gushing from its rocky crag.
Plunging from level to level,
it shatters into a thousand streams,
and then into thousands more, sending up clouds
of spray heaven high. And then,
gloriously rising from this storm of commotion,
the tinted arch of the rainbow’s changing permanence—
now sharply etched,
now melting into air—
scatters fragrant showers all around.
In this I see a mirror of human striving.
Consider, and it’s easily understood:
Life is not light, but the refracted color.

@@U02214@@
The throne room. STATE COUNCIL awaiting the EMPEROR.
Trumpets. Splendidly dressed COURTIERS of every sort step forward.
The EMPEROR ascends the throne, the ASTROLOGER at his right hand.

@@U02216@@
Most dear and loyal subjects,
I greet you assembled here from near and far.
I see my philosopher at my side,
but what has happened to my Fool?

@@U02218@@
As you mounted the stairs, Sire,
he collapsed just behind your trailing robe.
Dead or drunk, who knows?
They lugged that tub of lard away.

@@U02220@@
In the blink of an eye, Sire,
another presented himself on the spot.
Exquisitely dressed he may be,
but he’s so grotesque he frightens everyone.
He's being held at the door by guards

@@U02212@@
这座咆哮的瀑布从岩石峭壁中喷涌而出。
从一个层面跌落到另一个层面，
它碎成千条溪流，
然后又进入数千个，升起云彩
喷射天堂高。然后，
从这场骚乱的风暴中光荣地崛起，
彩虹永恒变化的彩色拱门——
现在被尖锐地蚀刻，
现在融化在空气中——
向四周洒下香雨。
在此我看到了人类奋斗的一面镜子。
想一想，就很容易理解了：
生命不是光，而是折射的色彩。

@@U02214@@
王座室。国务会议正在等待皇帝。
小号。衣着光鲜亮丽的各个朝臣向前迈出了一步。
皇帝登基，占星家在他的右手边。

@@U02216@@
最亲爱和忠诚的臣民，
我向远近聚集在这里的你们致以问候。
我看到我的哲学家就在我身边，
但我的傻瓜怎么了？

@@U02218@@
当您登上楼梯时，陛下，
他就倒在你拖着的长袍后面。
死了还是喝醉了，谁知道呢？
他们把那桶猪油拖走了。

@@U02220@@
一眨眼的功夫，陛下，
另一个人当场出现。
他可能衣着华丽，
但他太怪诞了，让所有人都害怕。
他被警卫拦在门口
